user.title: Set up Familienzentrale
user.description: The family planner for your wall. Configure modules, people and calendars afterwards via “Configure”.

module.title: Modules
module.description: Checked modules are active. Disabled modules are hidden and stopped – their data is kept.

personen.title: People
personen.description: Who belongs to the family? The people from Home Assistant are used (photo and name come from there). Next you set colour, keywords and phone for each person.

data_description.farbe: Events of this person are shown in this colour.
data_description.stichwoerter: Comma separated. If one of them is in the title, the event belongs to this person.
data_description.benachrichtigung: Receives pushes, e.g. for new events.

haustiere.title: Pets
haustiere.description: Pets appear like family members in the calendar – with an icon instead of a photo.

kalender.title: Calendars & push
kalender.description: Which calendars does the wall calendar show and watch for new events?

data.push_tage: Report new events within the next … days

data_description.push_tage: Events further in the future are reported once they move into this range.

essensplan.title: Meal plan
essensplan.description: Recipes and the weekly plan are managed in the “Familie” panel under 🍎 Essen.

data_description.einkaufsliste: Ingredients are added here with one tap (a to-do list).
data_description.essens_hinweise: E.g. “child aged 3, not spicy, little meat, max. 30 minutes on weekdays”.

punkte.title: Points & rewards
punkte.description: Routines and rewards are managed in the “Familie” panel under ✅ Aufgaben and 💎 Schätze.

data_description.sandi_zaehler: Rewards with “Sandi stars” add stars to this counter when redeemed.

kindersicherung.title: Child lock
kindersicherung.description: The parent PIN protects settings and redeeming rewards on the wall display.

data_description.pin: 4 to 8 digits. Leave empty = no PIN.

error.pin_ungueltig: The PIN must consist of 4 to 8 digits.
